title: Cute for X-mas, but not very high quality.
text: Cute for X-mas, but not very high quality.. These are suprisingly cute and bigger than I expected. They are not heavy though and don't feel very well made. You can see from the pictures in review how the base of both trivets has discolored and taken on a black, bubbled look. They are also slightly different from one another; the star shape is crisp on one and blobby on another. Same with the tree base. That said though, they are cute enough to use during the holidays. They will add a charm to the table and the 3 plastic feet won't slip around.
